openIssues.description: Bodhi places the second whole verse line before the Mogharaja attribution, whereas the Pali places the attribution between its first and second verse rows. The baseline preserves the source order by retaining two English verse lines on 7.1, but does not spread the second line to 7.3. Ordinary monotonic start directives cannot move that line to 7.3 while retaining the attribution on its own row and preserving source order.

Do not force a hand cut or alter source text.
